entry.title: Starting a research blog
entry.content:
Welcome to my new research blog. This site just moved over to al-folio, which makes it much easier for me to write things up as I go — paper notes, project write-ups, and the occasional longer post on continual learning and reinforcement learning ideas I’m chewing on.

Expect posts to be fairly informal. If you’re here from a paper, publication, or project link, welcome — check out the projects and publications pages for the more polished version of my work.
entry.summary: Why I'm adding a blog to this site, and what to expect here.
